pairs: Adjuvantes autem exhortamur ne in vacuum gratiam Dei recipiatis.
But, as a help to you, we exhort you not to receive the grace of God in vain.
“In a favorable time, I heeded you;
et in die salutis adjuvi te.
and on the day of salvation, I helped you.”
Behold, now is the favorable time; behold,
now is the day of salvation.
May we never give offense to anyone,
so that our ministry may not be disparaged.
sed in omnibus exhibeamus nosmetipsos sicut Dei ministros in multa patientia,
But in all things, let us exhibit ourselves as ministers of God with great patience:
per arma justitiæ a dextris et a sinistris,
and with the armor of justice to the right and to the left;
Our mouth is open to you,
You are not narrowed by us,
but it is by your own inner selves that you are narrowed.
eamdem autem habentes remunerationem, tamquam filiis dico,
But since we have the same recompense, (I am speaking as if to my own sons),
Do not choose to bear the yoke with unbelievers.
Quæ enim participatio justitiæ cum iniquitate?
For how can justice be a participant with iniquity?
aut quæ societas luci ad tenebras?
Or how can the fellowship of light be a participant with darkness?
quæ autem conventio Christi ad Belial?
And how can Christ join together with Belial?
aut quæ pars fideli cum infideli?
Or what part do the faithful have with the unfaithful?
qui autem consensus templo Dei cum idolis?
And what consensus does the temple of God have with idols?
vos enim estis templum Dei vivi,
For you are the temple of the living God,
and I will walk among them.
And I will be their God,
and they shall be my people.
Propter quod exite de medio eorum,
you must depart from their midst and be separate,
And do not touch what is unclean.
And I will be a Father to you,
et vos eritis mihi in filios et filias,
and you shall be sons and daughters to me,
